description: Get Anycast CDN metrics for the whole account or a single resource. Select a period either with period+date (e.g. period='month', date='2026-08-01') or with from+to timestamps. Metric types: bandwidth, cache, cache_requests, responses (HTTP codes), traffic, hybrid, cloud_storage.

from.description: Period start, e.g. '2026-08-01 00:00:00 UTC' (use with to)

resource_id.description: aCDN resource ID. Omit for account-wide metrics.

scale.description: Data point granularity. minute: period <= day; hour: period <= month.

name: get_cdn_metrics
title: Get CDN metrics
